name: pdmartins
description: Pedro Martins' Claude Code plugins. Currently: rules-by-trigger (path-scoped rules injected into context) and chat-frames (frames around each prompt and reply in the transcript).

plugins.name: rules-by-trigger
plugins.description: Path-scoped rules for Claude Code: markdown rules auto-injected into context the moment Claude touches a file matching a glob, or loads a named skill. A scalable replacement for nested CLAUDE.md files.

plugins.name: chat-frames
plugins.description: Frames each user prompt (blue) and assistant reply block (terracotta) in the transcript with a timestamped top rule, a closing rule and a dark tinted background.
